authorship: Explicit per-ID scene rows authored after inspecting all 300 original names, types and effect texts. No regex classifier generates subjects or settings.

visualDirection.lighting: Coherent window/daylight for most scenes; scene-required night/studio lighting stays restrained.
visualDirection.characterDiversity: Distinct fictional adult identities and anatomically credible hands/faces; identities must be designed per scene, never reuse one face with a wardrobe change.
visualDirection.compositionPolicy: Composition labels are planning categories, not reusable plate templates. Every scene retains its explicit subject, action, setting and effect relation.
visualDirection.nonnumericEffects: Art suggests actions and trade-offs; all exact costs, timings and rewards remain solely in unchanged source/UI text.

production.gate: Do not scale failed SND-001 probe or claim these briefs are completed cards.
production.futurePipeline: Replacing only public WebP is insufficient: approved final art must update scripts/duel-art-packs and truthful manifests with offline/version and immutable-data regression evidence.
